messages:
Aisha (Product): Quick recap from today — thanks everyone for the questions. Two asks we promised to clarify: exact timing for the public API surface changes, when the Console route-level dashboards hit beta, and the Optimize recommendations rollout. Can we get specific windows so teams can plan migrations?
Sam (Eng): API changes: expecting breaking SDK change in the client on the week of May 20. Hosted API endpoints remain backward-compatible for one release cycle, but SDK helpers for batching will be renamed. We'll publish a migration guide.
Jordan (Eng-ML): For Optimize: phase 1 (server-side recommendations + UI flag) is targeting June 3 internal beta. Phase 2 (automated suggestions + autoscale integrations) is penciled for late July — dependent on quantization tuning results.
Maya (DevRel): Can we get an example migration snippet for the SDK rename? Even a copy-paste will help customers.
Sam (Eng): Yep — minimal change. Example: 
```js
// old
const resp = await Redwood.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', batch: true })
// new
const resp = await Redwood.text.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', batching: { enabled: true } })
```
We'll include the above and a compatibility table in the guide.
Aisha (Product): Console dashboards — ETA? We heard "this quarter" in the talk, can we call out alpha vs beta vs GA?
Jordan (Eng-ML): Dashboard alpha (internal) = June 10. Beta (external opt-in) = July 8. GA = Sept 15. Alpha will have per-route latency/cost breakdown, beta adds token-level heatmaps and rollout annotations.
Tara (Leadership): Important note: Dedicated customers get early access to beta for the Console because of SLA alignment. We'll coordinate invites next week. @Maya can you draft the invite copy?
Maya (DevRel): On it — I'll post a short template in #product-updates by EOD Fri.
Sam (Eng): Quick note on Optimize autoscale integration: we need to validate bbox on burst scenarios. Plan: synthetic load tests w/ KV cache disabled and enabled, target dates June 24–28.
Jordan (Eng-ML): Also tracking quantization regressions — we have a small eval set for LLM-quality checks. If any regression > 2% ROUGE on baseline, we hold automated rollouts.
Aisha (Product): Can leadership confirm that those timelines are non-negotiable or flexible? Some customers asked for earlier GA.
Tara (Leadership): We're prioritizing reliability over rushing GA. Timelines above are the target commitment. If early beta signals are strong we can accelerate specific customers, but public GA stays as scheduled.
Sam (Eng): Action items: 1) Publish SDK migration guide by May 18. 2) Post Console alpha checklist May 30. 3) Run Optimize load tests June 24–28 and share perf report. I'll own 1 and 3.
Jordan (Eng-ML): I'll own 2 and the evaluation pass.
Maya (DevRel): I'll own communications and the beta invite.
Aisha (Product): Thanks — can we get a short follow-up doc in the product repo with the bullets and dates? If someone posts it here, I'll pin to the all-hands thread.
deploy-bot: [deployment] canary:console-dashboards succeeded (build 4823) :rocket:  
Sam (Eng): Nice — that canary run is the alpha baseline. We'll add instrumentation and re-run tomorrow with larger traces.
Maya (DevRel): I'll draft the public-facing changelog blurb once the migration guide lands.
Tara (Leadership): Appreciate the clarity. Aisha — please coordinate a 15-min sync next week if anything slips.
Aisha (Product): Will do. Thanks everyone — I'll post the follow-up doc in 24 hours.
